summary: Extend exact shared radical geometry to 627 glyphs, separating semantic allographs and positions.
method: Classify recurring whole components by radical family, allograph and slot before sharing geometry.
Copy reviewed canonical paths exactly into each registered instance and reflow the remaining strokes within bounded affine scales.
Keep distinct mouth and sun slots, and connected and detached insect forms, as separate templates.
Accept transformed candidates after independent visual review and complete whole-path contact measurements.

regular30_contact_scope.scope: All distinct whole-path pairs, including body/body and remainder/remainder; closed segments are included.
regular30_contact_scope.comparison: New contacts and losses of a prior half-unit safety margin are compared against the bound source glyph.

final_changed_source_coverage.stage_overlap_policy: Four glyphs changed by both a role assignment and a parent refinement have separate baseline-to-final contact audits.

visual_review.outlier_policy: A large centroid shift triggers visual review; it is not itself a rejection.
